name: Oumagatoki ~Kakuriyo no Enishi~
original_name: 逢魔が刻 ~かくりよの縁~
source:
Sakaki Mio is a completely ordinary high school student.

...However, perhaps having been influenced by her grandmother who had raised her, Mio can be somewhat old-fashioned. As a result, she's often isolated by girls of the same generation. She becomes too focused on others' feelings, and becomes unable to open her mouth. Mio has been told that she "has a good intuition", but she's never really paid much attention to those words.

One evening, she got spirited away during the twilight into the realm of the dead and becomes lost in a secluded country of perpetual night. A world in which beings that are non-existent in the world of the living come and go, Mio meets various "lives".

The young girl was invited into a chinju (Shinto tutelary god) school, in which its attendees protect the world order by hunting down youkai (Japanese ghosts, demons and other supernatural creatures) that disturb the peace within the realm of the dead. Mio then gets embroiled in an incident that shakes up both the world of the living and the realm of the dead.

[Translation of [URL=http://joqrextend.co.jp/extend/oumagatoki/story/]official website story summary[/URL].]
translation:
榊澪是一名极其普通的高中生。

……然而，也许受养育自己的祖母影响，澪多少有些老派。因此，她经常被同龄女孩孤立。她太过在意他人的感受，渐渐变得无法开口说话。别人常说她“直觉很好”，但她从未真正把这些话放在心上。

某个黄昏，她被神隐带入冥界，迷失在一片永夜的偏僻国度。这个世界中，现实世界不存在的生灵来来往往，澪在那里遇见了各式各样的“生命”。

少女受邀进入一所镇守神学校。学校的学生负责猎杀扰乱冥界和平的妖怪，以维护世界秩序。澪由此卷入一场同时撼动生界与冥界的事件。

[翻译自 [URL=http://joqrextend.co.jp/extend/oumagatoki/story/]官方网站故事简介[/URL]]
